additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues, we have a Router 1 that is not turning on or similar. CPO tried to restart charger via OCPP but still doesn't come online in SCB.
Please check via WebUI the status of the router. You can try to do a restore default settings in the Backup tab, if you are able to access the WebUI.
If it doesn't work, please test a factory reset.
If it doesn't work, please replace the router
